七牛的原生接口封装：空间存储与 CDN 的基本操作，由平台进程内的签名执行器承接: Qiniu Cloud's native API wrapper: basic bucket storage and CDN operations, handled by the platform's in-process signing executor,
列一次空间验证 AK/SK 是否可用（只读，不产生费用）: Lists the bucket once to verify the AccessKey/SecretKey work (read-only, no cost)
列出存储空间内文件（可按前缀过滤，marker 翻页）: Lists files in the bucket (optionally filtered by prefix, paginated with a marker)
删除空间内的一个文件: Deletes a file in the bucket
刷新 CDN 缓存（URL 或目录）: Refreshes the CDN cache (URLs or directories)
查询单个文件的元信息（大小/类型/上传时间等）: Queries a single file's metadata (size, type, upload time, etc.)
生成客户端直传用的上传 token（本地签名，不出网）: Generates an upload token for direct client uploads (signed locally, no outbound request)
预取资源到 CDN 边缘节点: Prefetches resources to CDN edge nodes
